summary: To regenerate a compromised SECRET_KEY, back up the database, then run `setup.sh -k` with your install inventory; the previous key is saved in /etc/tower/.
questions: How do I rotate the automation controller SECRET_KEY?

answer_card.title: Regenerate the controller SECRET_KEY
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Back up the controller database (backup/restore procedure).
2. With the same inventory used for install/backups:
```bash
./setup.sh -k
```
The old key is kept as a backup in `/etc/tower/`.
